text: At 276640b on hg38noN with 32 threads, --memory-budget 6400 is the fastest budget at 35.7 s; 3200 takes 43.0 s and 12800 and 25600 take 42.5 s with lower CPU use. In the --log info run at 6400 the read took 4.5 s and normalize about 5.3 s, inferred from the gap, both on one thread; then gather 3.8 s and sort plus write 21.9 s at about 22 of 32 cores. numactl on one node changed nothing. Logs: ~/sufr-benchmarks/results/profile/ on catalyst. Measured 2026-11-05.
